        return -1 
    
    a = n // 10
    b = n % 10
    return a + 3 * b

def simulate(start_n, max_k=50):
    """
    Simulates f^k(start_n) up to max_k and prints the sequence.
    """
    sequence = [start_n]
    current_n = start_n
    
    # We track up to max_k applications, resulting in k+1 numbers in the list

        next_n = f(current_n)
